hashes: Artifact SHA-256 values identify raw file bytes. Engine inputHash/profileHash use the engine identity scheme.

checks.scope: Design results, DTO consistency, independently reviewed source interpretations, parser feasibility and retained compatibility. No proposed Trace runtime API exists.

initialExample.scope: Hand-authored ledger consistency only; no proposed API executed

languageIndex.procedure: Verify 55 unique sequential case IDs, 15 rule IDs and exact unchanged rule/case mapping from revision 5; pair every source with a matching case annotation.

corpusParser.scope: Public Engine structure/source only; no semantic facts extracted

independentInterpretation.scope: Original source interpretation only; new API results have separate checker/maintainer evidence.

contextOracle.basis: Focused original oracle remains unchanged. Full context result DTOs now cover every usable language root and all scenario context/budget/ambiguity variants in the result corpus. Source semantics retain EP-GATE-1 evidence; API result proof is EP-ACT-3.

resultTypes.scope: DTO shape checks only; opaque runtime brands are deliberately excluded from serialized selection images.

resultWalk.scope: Bounded maintainer result walk; EP-GATE-2 remains after EP-ACT-4.

remainingGates: EP-ACT-4 and EP-GATE-2: reconcile declarations/consumer and first-delivery compatibility against the complete result corpus.
EP-ACT-5/EP-GATE-3: final parent-task evidence and compatibility handoff.
Q-1/Q-2: owner syntax selection and authoring-fit acceptance before extraction.
Q-3: public export/schema acceptance before the new package surface.
Q-4: representative context oracle and scale targets before pilot/release claims.
